wins: Fill your graveyard with big cycling creatures, then cascade into Living End: your creatures return, theirs die. Attack with the new army.
plan: Cycle creatures (Street Wraith costs 2 life, no mana). Overlord of the Balemurk mills five. Don’t cast your creatures; you want them in the graveyard.
Cast Shardless Agent or Violent Outburst. Cascade always finds Living End, the deck’s only cheaper spell.
Living End swaps the boards. Attack with 5–8 big creatures; games usually end in a turn or two.
keys: Instant-speed cascade. Best during the opponent’s turn after they declare attackers: their attackers die, your army is ready.
Free counterspell on the opponent’s turn (exile a blue card) to protect the combo.
Cast free by exiling a card of the same color; they go straight to the graveyard as fuel.
tips: You can’t hard-cast Living End (no mana cost). Let cascade find it.
Playmat handles cascade automatically: always say yes to casting the hit.
Watch for graveyard hate (Endurance, Consign to Memory, Rest in Peace) and cascade before it lands.
mulligan: Keep 2–3 lands, a couple of cyclers, and Shardless Agent or Violent Outburst.
sideboard: Inevitable Betrayal (it can also be a cascade hit, so only when worth it)
